PullRequest.Title: SessionCustomizationDiscovery: print working directory on error
PullRequest.Body:

Scenarios.Scenario: Session customization discovery on initial load and filesystem/configuration-triggered refresh, including SDK discovery failure logging
Scenarios.CriticalPath: In discover mode, progress waits for three SDK discovery RPCs, local hook discovery, watcher resolution, and any discovered skill/plugin parsing. The changed expression runs only in the terminal non-cancellation error handler after one of those operations fails, immediately before returning an empty result; it is not on successful discovery's critical path.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Invoke agents.discover, instructions.discover, and skills.discover against the Copilot SDK.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: Three concurrent RPC calls per effective refresh, each carrying the complete projectPaths array; no per-workspace RPC fan-out.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The same three concurrent RPCs ran with the same request and critical-path placement.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: All are awaited by the refresh; a rejection reaches the changed catch block.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Resolve watcher ancestors, scan hook roots, parse discovered skill/plugin files, and locate plugin manifests.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One batched resolveAll for deduplicated watcher paths, fixed hook-root resolves, one skill parse per discovered non-plugin/non-builtin skill, and manifest probes/parsing per effective plugin file/root.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The same filesystem operations and cardinality existed before the diff.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: These operations are part of the existing Promise.all discovery phase or subsequent projection; failures can reach the changed catch block.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Emit an error record through the configured log service/sinks.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One existing error call per non-cancellation failed effective refresh; the diff increases payload bytes by the joined project paths, O(number of workspace roots times path length).
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The error boundary call already occurred once per failed refresh, but without project paths in its payload.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Synchronous message construction and logger dispatch occur before the failed refresh returns; sink persistence is implementation-dependent.

Scenarios.ScalingInput: The added CPU/allocation and log-byte cost scales linearly with the number and total character length of primary plus additional workspace roots. Typical sessions have a small root list, and refresh triggers are debounced for 100 ms and cancel/coalesce prior in-flight refreshes.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: The three SDK discovery calls and local hook/watcher tasks run concurrently inside one refresh. SessionDiscoveredEntry uses a Delayer and cancels the prior CancelablePromise, so rapid file/configuration events coalesce rather than creating an unbounded aggregate of active refreshes from this owner.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: Discovery-path metadata is loaded once into _discoveredDirectories and reused on warm refreshes. The changed error formatting has no cache and runs once whenever the main discovery phase fails; successful warm and cold paths do not execute it.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High confidence in the exact added mechanism and reachability: the diff eagerly joins projectPaths only in the non-cancellation catch, while all expensive discovery boundaries and the log call itself pre-existed.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Configured logger fan-out and unusually large multi-root workspaces can increase bytes written, but no evidence shows realistic root counts or failure frequency large enough for the added single join to create measurable latency, CPU/GC pressure, or I/O regression.
Scenarios.Verdict: No reportable performance regression. The PR adds only O(total project-path text) formatting and corresponding log bytes on an already-failing, debounced refresh; it adds no boundary call, fan-out, cache loss, concurrency burst, or successful-path work.

Analysis.Summary: Completed the performance pass over the sole changed hunk and traced cold/warm discovery, refresh scheduling, SDK RPCs, filesystem work, and logging. No high-confidence actionable performance issue was introduced.

Stats.CostNote: Copilot SDK reports nano-AI units and model billing multipliers; it does not provide a USD conversion.
